item.title: Home Again of the Lowcountry Marks Record-Breaking Year in 2025, Completing 55 Move-Ins
item.description: Home Again of the Lowcountry is closing out 2025 with deep gratitude and a major milestone, marking a record-breaking year with 55 completed move-ins for individuals and families transitioning out of homelessness.

item.title: Author Kathryn Austin to Host Book Event at La Cave on Jan. 10
item.description: Author Kathryn Austin will host a special in-person event on Jan.10 from 12 p.m. to 2 p.m. at La Cave (550 King Street) to celebrate her book, My Mother’s Other Daughter.

item.title: Patriots Point to Offer "Pay What You Can" Saturdays Every Weekend in January
item.description: Patriots Point Naval & Maritime Museum will allow visitors to name their admission price every Saturday in January during the museum’s “Pay What You Can” days.

item.title: Evette Campaign Kicks Off New Year With Over $1 Million Raised
item.description: Lt. Governor Pamela Evette’s campaign this week announced it had raised over $1 million in the fourth quarter of 2025 — a sum that they said includes no personal investment, bringing her fundraising total to $2.4 million since launching her campaign.
